answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in wander, expire in glacier, and zephyr lists each expiry. An attacker running 132 aliases thus needs 79 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 738 identities would post 4031 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
